# Hood pin kit installation

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

Drill holes, install pins and dimple spots, then create larger holes through the skin for a hood pin kit. [t927]

## Tools

- [Partial] .5-inch drill bit [t927]
- File [t927]

## Parts

- [Partial] Flat scuff plates [t927]
- Hood pin kit, Jegs Racing black anodized aluminum, .5" diameter x 2 3/4" long [t927]
- [Partial] Keeper clips [t927]

## Specifications

- **.5-inch drill bit**: .5" [t927] ([Unverified] single report)

## Tips & gotchas

- [Partial] Use HD washers on both sides of the core support pins for stability. [t927]
- Cut shock bushings in half to use as rest stops under the hood if rubber hood stops are removed. [t927]
